@jgengine/core is the bottom package: every other package imports it, so it imports none of them. Move what both need into core, or put this file in the package it depends on. Only core's *.draw files may load @jgengine/ws (the player's transport). See docs/architecture.md.
A published package imports only @jgengine packages below it, never apps/, games/, registry/ or examples/. See docs/architecture.md.
